tools.name: list_runbooks
tools.description: Search runbooks visible to this agent. Returns id, one-line description, risk. No schemas.

query.description: Substring of id, alias, or description.

tools.name: describe_runbook
tools.description: Get one runbook: args schema, risk, script. Read it before run_runbook.

tools.name: run_runbook
tools.description: Run one runbook with args. Secrets come from the local vault; never pass them. Above your grant it does not run and returns pending_grant.

args.description: Parameter name to value, per describe_runbook.

dry_run.description: Resolve args and env names without executing.

tools.name: propose_runbook
tools.description: Draft a new runbook for human review. Writes files and returns a diff; never registers or runs it.
